summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Aetherion Reserve game. All backend APIs, core gameplay systems, UI components, and integration flows tested successfully. Backend CRUD operations, canvas-based gameplay, creature management, unknown biology discovery, guest economy, research system, and save/load functionality all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: All /api/saves CRUD endpoints (10/10 tests)
Backend: Root endpoint, list saves, create save with full state, get by ID, update, delete, 404 handling
Backend: Metadata fields validation (id, name, park_name, mode, day, cash, rating, creatures, updated_at)
Main Menu: Title display, park name input, mode selection (Management/Sandbox), BEGIN OPERATIONS button, canvas loading
HUD: Cash display (◈150,000 management, ◈9,999,999 sandbox), pause button, speed buttons (1x/3x), guest count, rating, modal buttons
HUD: Field Ops, Species Database, Research, Finances modals open/close correctly
Build Toolbar: All 8 category tabs (terrain, ground, water, flora, paths, fences, habitat, facilities)
Build Toolbar: Brush size buttons (1/2/3), tool selection working
Build Toolbar: Locked tools in management mode (deep water, tier 2+ fences require research)
Canvas Tools: Flatten terrain, raise terrain, paint materials, place shallow water, place paths
Canvas Tools: Undo button functional, costs deducted correctly
Enclosure Flow: Fence perimeter placement, gate placement, enclosure detection, enclosure panel shows composition/security/residents
Creature Acquisition: Field Ops modal shows 15 species, tier 2/3 locked in management (UNRESOLVED SIGNAL), all unlocked in sandbox
Creature Acquisition: Acquire and release creatures inside enclosure, error toast when releasing outside enclosure
Creature Behavior: Creatures contained within fences, no escapes, activity states (seekTerrain, seekSocial, seekSwim)
Creature Behavior: Welfare tracking (0.76-0.8), needs bars, stress, environment factors
Unknown Biology: Veyra species shows UNKNOWN redacted fields (water, social) in Species Database
Unknown Biology: Knowledge level 'Unclassified' shown initially, Skitterling 'Fully Documented'
Unknown Biology: Evidence accrual (social: 8, water: 6 after 20s at 3x speed)
Unknown Biology: Field hypothesis alerts appear, dynamic research projects generated
Unknown Biology: Biological breakthrough toast fires, discovery recorded (social structure identified)
Guests + Economy: Admin building + path from entrance enables guest spawning
Guests + Economy: Guest count increases (6 → 25 over 20s), ticket income generated (◈625)
Guests + Economy: Finances modal shows income breakdown (tickets, grants) and expense breakdown (construction, terrain, acquisition, research)
Research: Research modal opens, lab requirement enforced (button disabled without lab)
Research: Research projects start with lab, progress tracking, completion alerts
Research: Prerequisites enforced (bio_obs2 locked until bio_obs1 done)
Objectives: Objectives panel shows undone objectives, completion fires toast and grants cash
Objectives: 'Open the Gates' (+◈1,500), 'Learn Something True' (+◈2,000) completed
Alerts: Alerts button opens dropdown with history, alert navigation working
Overlays: Habitat, power, view overlay buttons toggle without errors
Save/Load: Save button creates save with toast 'archived', exit to menu shows save slots
Save/Load: Loading save restores heights, creatures, fences, cash exactly (verified via window.__game.state)
Stability: No page errors during 2-minute 3x-speed session with creatures + guests active
Stability: Canvas rendering stable, no console errors (only willReadFrequently warning)
